chain.text:
**Established:** 60 cm reflector (2017), 20 cm refractor for outreach. ~195 useful nights/year; 168 in 2024 (wet autumn). ~400 GB/month, transferred nightly to Marseille university server, 40 min.

**Decided:** New camera (March 2025) after two cooling failures; 30% lower read noise. Firmware update pending — needs one full offline night.

**Failed/fixed:** 2023 dome motor seized; telescope hit dome wall, counterweight rod bent. Rod replaced, limit switch added. Feb 2025: 1.2 s timestamp offset lost three weeks of photometry; now GPS-checked each session.

**Planned:** Spanish simultaneous-observation collaboration (2025).

**Open:** Shared scheduling tool unevaluated; network link capacity for simultaneous transfers unknown.

**Rules:** No runs during outreach evenings. Raw frames never deleted, compressed after two years. Acquisition-software changes need a test night.
